## 📝 Descrição

## 1. What happened and what were you expecting?

During the execution of the new test plan for the consents extension, there is a new validation for the refresh token that isn't expecting to receive a JWT. In that case what should be returned in the refresh token field ? 

Could you share some example and also the documentation that explain that, pls?

## 💬 Notas e Comentários (1)

### Comentário 1
**Autor**: Christian Eloysio (@christianraidiam)
**Criado em**: 09/10/2023, 16:29:25

Hi Lucas! Thanks for the ticket!

The error you are receiving is because the refresh_token being sent is a JWT, which can't be used at the Simplified Consent Renewal journey. This reason is available at the [latests Consent API Swagger](https://openfinancebrasil.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OF/pages/189694174/Informa+es+T+cnicas+-+Consentimento+-+v2.2.0-beta.2): 

* A renovação de consentimento (**`POST /consents/{consentId}/extends`**) deve ser possível para consentimento para o qual foi emitido um refresh token opaco. Não deve ser possível quando o consentimento está vinculado a um refresh token do tipo JWT (com prazo não prorrogável). A transmissora deve retornar status de erro 422 (**`REFRESH_TOKEN_JWT`**) para requisições que não seguem essa definição.

The rationale for this lies in the fact that JWTs may contain an optional "exp" claim. [By the specs](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc7519#section-4.1.4), once included, this claim cannot be altered after token issuance. Consequently, even if consent is extended, the client would not be able to access resources if the refresh token expires. Thus, the only viable option in this scenario would be to use opaque refresh tokens.

The upcoming security specification updates will handle this alteration. To ensure compliance with the testing requirements, you must be capable of issuing opaque refresh tokens instead of JWT ones. If your server does not currently support opaque refresh tokens and won't be able to make the necessary adjustments before the certification deadline, we kindly request that you submit a ticket regarding this issue to the Service Desk Platform.
